LaboratoryContracts.hodge_family_certificate (ε : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
  ResearchBridge.hodgeMatrix ε 0 0 1 = !![ε ^ 2, 0; 0, 1] ∧
    (∀ (a b : ℝ), ε ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ≤ ResearchBridge.hodgeEnergy ε 0 0 1 a b) ∧ (0 < ε ^ 2 ↔ ε ≠ 0)

LaboratoryContracts.hodge_family_kernel (ε a b : ℝ) :
  (ResearchBridge.hodgeMatrix ε 0 0 1).mulVec ![a, b] = 0 ↔ (ε = 0 ∨ a = 0) ∧ b = 0
LaboratoryContracts.square_perturbation_bound (B e d : ℝ) (he : |e| ≤ d) : |(B + e) ^ 2 - B ^ 2| ≤ d * (2 * |B| + d)

CosmologyCalibration.finite_family_false_positive_bound.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (tests : Finset ι) (events : ι → Set Ω)
  (budget : ι → ℝ) (hmeas : ∀ j ∈ tests, MeasurableSet (events j)) (htail : ∀ j ∈ tests, μ.real (events j) ≤ budget j) :
  MeasurableSet (⋃ j ∈ tests, events j) ∧ μ.real (⋃ j ∈ tests, events j) ≤ min 1 (∑ j ∈ tests, budget j)

CosmologyCalibration.scan_even_moment_bound.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (tests : Finset ι) (score : ι → Ω → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
  (t : ℝ) (M : ι → ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (hmeas : ∀ j ∈ tests, Measurable (score j))
  (hint : ∀ j ∈ tests, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => |score j ω| ^ (2 * k)) μ)
  (hmoment : ∀ j ∈ tests, ∫ (ω : Ω), |score j ω| ^ (2 * k) ∂μ ≤ M j) :
  MeasurableSet (CosmologyCalibration.scanEvent tests score t) ∧
    μ.real (CosmologyCalibration.scanEvent tests score t) ≤ min 1 ((∑ j ∈ tests, M j) / t ^ (2 * k))

CosmologyCalibration.scan_uniform_even_moment_bound.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (tests : Finset ι) (score : ι → Ω → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
  (t M : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (hmeas : ∀ j ∈ tests, Measurable (score j))
  (hint : ∀ j ∈ tests, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => |score j ω| ^ (2 * k)) μ)
  (hmoment : ∀ j ∈ tests, ∫ (ω : Ω), |score j ω| ^ (2 * k) ∂μ ≤ M) :
  MeasurableSet (CosmologyCalibration.scanEvent tests score t) ∧
    μ.real (CosmologyCalibration.scanEvent tests score t) ≤ min 1 (↑tests.card * M / t ^ (2 * k))

CosmologyCalibration.scan_even_moment_threshold.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (tests : Finset ι) (score : ι → Ω → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
  (t M α : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (hmeas : ∀ j ∈ tests, Measurable (score j))
  (hint : ∀ j ∈ tests, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => |score j ω| ^ (2 * k)) μ)
  (hmoment : ∀ j ∈ tests, ∫ (ω : Ω), |score j ω| ^ (2 * k) ∂μ ≤ M) (hbudget : ↑tests.card * M ≤ α * t ^ (2 * k)) :
  MeasurableSet (CosmologyCalibration.scanEvent tests score t) ∧
    μ.real (CosmologyCalibration.scanEvent tests score t) ≤ α

CosmologyCalibration.rank_fraction_bounds (draws exceedances : ℕ) (hcount : exceedances ≤ draws) :
  0 < CosmologyCalibration.rankFraction draws exceedances ∧
    1 / (↑draws + 1) ≤ CosmologyCalibration.rankFraction draws exceedances ∧
      CosmologyCalibration.rankFraction draws exceedances ≤ 1

CosmologyCalibration.rank_fraction_threshold_iff (draws exceedances : ℕ) (α : ℚ) :
  CosmologyCalibration.rankFraction draws exceedances ≤ α ↔ 1 + ↑exceedances ≤ α * (↑draws + 1)
